record.question: Captain Lalrinawma Sailo who was recently announced to be awarded the gallantry award – Kirti Chakra. What is the Kirti Chakra?
options: It is the highest peacetime military decoration
It is the second in order of precedence of peacetime gallantry awards
It is the third in order of precedence of peacetime gallantry awards
record.explanation: Answer B: It is the second in order of precedence of peacetime gallantry awards. Kirti Chakra is second in precedence among India’s peacetime gallantry decorations. Reference: https://www.gallantryawards.gov.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
